title: Apply for document translation services
summary: You can book an appointment and submit documents at a Service NSW Centre to get documents translated into English or another language.
intro:
If you need documents translated into English, or from English into another language, you can book an appointment and submit the documents for translation at a Service NSW Centre.

If you need an interpreter, refer to Book an interpreter for spoken language.

Document translation services are available to:

Note: You can request translation services on behalf of another person.
who_can_apply: You can request translation services for yourself or on behalf of another person.
what_you_need: Your original or certified document(s) for translation
Your reference number or confirmation email (received after submitting the Translation Lodgement Form)

how_to_steps.text: Complete the Translation Lodgement Form. Note: You can view this form in other languages.
Book an appointment at a service centre.
Attend your appointment with the document(s) to be translated, your Translation Lodgement Form confirmation email and your payment.

internal_links.text: Book an interpreter for spoken language
Support and guidance for new arrivals
Provide language interpretation for a statutory declaration

faqs.a: Services are available for translating various documents, including driver licences, marriage certificates, divorce certificates, birth certificates, death certificates, passport extracts, baptismal certificates, and family entries.

faqs.q: How do I start the translation process?
faqs.a: First, complete the Translation Lodgement Form. You can view this form in other languages. After that, book an appointment at a Service NSW Centre.

faqs.q: What do I need to bring to my appointment?
faqs.a: You need your original or certified document(s) for translation, your reference number or confirmation email, and your payment.
